messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have heartburn that has lasted for over 3 months"
set: ["ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have heartburn that has lasted for over 3 months", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have liver disease", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have frequent chest pain, heartburn with wheezing", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have unexplained weight loss", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have trouble or pain with swallowing", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have nausea or vomiting, stomach pain", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if you have questions", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "ask doctor if safe to breastfeed while using medicine", "ask doctor or pharmacist if unsure how to use injection", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you need help", "ask your doctor if you can keep using this medicine after 6 months of daily use", "ask your doctor or pharmacist first if you need a painkiller", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using gabapentin", "ask pharmacist for measuring device if you do not have one", "tell your doctor or pharmacist if you have a latex allergy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
